<span style="text-decoration: underline;">***IMPORTANT NOTE:***</span>** **In Module 3.2, we're going to take a step back from our WGS analysis pipeline and learn some theory. Specifically, we'll learn about **pairwise sequence alignment algorithms**, which form the backbone of many genome annotation pipelines (we'll come back to this in Module 3.2)\! **The videos below say "Module 1", but don't worry, you're in the right place\!** (based on student feedback, we've rearranged the course a bit, so these lectures, which were previously part of Module 1, are now part of Module 3)

 

## **Lectures (4 total)**

  - **Lecture 1:** Pairwise sequence alignment Part I: Dot-matrix method


  - <span>**Lecture 2:** </span>Pairwise sequence alignment Part II: <span>Global alignment with dynamic programming</span>


  - **Lecture 3:** Pairwise sequence alignment <span>Part III: Local alignment with dynamic programming</span>


  - **Lecture 4:** Pairwise sequence alignment Part <span>IV: </span><span>Word/</span>*<span>k</span>*<span>-tuple methods</span>
